import os
import time
import random
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.utils.class_weight import compute_class_weight
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score
)

from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Input,
    Conv1D,
    BatchNormalization,
    Bidirectional,
    LSTM,
    GlobalAveragePooling1D,
    Dense,
    Dropout
)
from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import EarlyStopping

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TRAIN_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_train_scaled.csv"
)

TEST_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_test_scaled.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\AFS_CMN_Optimizer_Comparison"
)

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGET = "Crisis_Risk_Level"

RANDOM_STATE = 42

FINAL_EPOCHS = 5
SEARCH_EPOCHS = 5
BATCH_SIZE = 32
PATIENCE = 7

# Metaheuristic search settings
POPULATION_SIZE = 2
OPTIMIZER_ITERATIONS = 2

np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
tf.random.set_seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

exclude_columns = [
    TARGET,
    "Crisis_Label"
]

feature_columns = [
    col for col in train_df.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns
    if col not in exclude_columns and col in test_df.columns
]

X_train = train_df[feature_columns].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
X_test = test_df[feature_columns].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

y_train = train_df[TARGET].to_numpy(dtype=np.int32)
y_test = test_df[TARGET].to_numpy(dtype=np.int32)

if not np.isfinite(X_train).all() or not np.isfinite(X_test).all():
    raise ValueError("Features contain NaN or infinite values.")

# ============================================================
# 3. PCA
# ============================================================

pca = PCA(
    n_components=0.95,
    svd_solver="full"
)

X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_train).astype(np.float32)
X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test).astype(np.float32)

print("=" * 85)
print("AFS-CMN OPTIMIZER COMPARISON")
print("=" * 85)

# ============================================================
# 4. TRAINING AND VALIDATION SPLIT
# ============================================================

X_fit, X_val, y_fit, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_pca,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    stratify=y_train
)

num_classes = len(np.unique(y_train))

# Class weights calculated from original training partition
classes = np.unique(y_fit)

weight_values = compute_class_weight(
    class_weight="balanced",
    classes=classes,
    y=y_fit
)

class_weights = {
    int(cls): float(weight)
    for cls, weight in zip(classes, weight_values)
}

# CNN-BiLSTM input format
def reshape_data(X):
    return X.reshape(
        X.shape[0],
        X.shape[1],
        1
    ).astype(np.float32)


X_fit_3d = reshape_data(X_fit)
X_val_3d = reshape_data(X_val)
X_test_3d = reshape_data(X_test_pca)

# ============================================================
# 5. SEARCH SPACE
# ============================================================

# Parameter vector:
# [learning_rate_log10, CNN_filters, BiLSTM_units, dropout]

LOWER = np.array([
    -4.0,
    32,
    32,
    0.10
], dtype=float)

UPPER = np.array([
    -2.0,
    128,
    128,
    0.50
], dtype=float)


def decode_parameters(position):

    learning_rate = 10 ** position[0]

    filters = int(
        np.clip(
            round(position[1] / 16) * 16,
            32,
            128
        )
    )

    units = int(
        np.clip(
            round(position[2] / 16) * 16,
            32,
            128
        )
    )

    dropout = float(
        np.clip(position[3], 0.10, 0.50)
    )

    return {
        "learning_rate": learning_rate,
        "filters": filters,
        "units": units,
        "dropout": dropout
    }


# ============================================================
# 6. AFS-CMN MODEL
# ============================================================

def build_afs_cmn(params):

    model = Sequential([
        Input(
            shape=(X_fit_3d.shape[1], 1)
        ),

        Conv1D(
            filters=params["filters"],
            kernel_size=3,
            padding="same",
            activation="relu"
        ),

        BatchNormalization(),

        Bidirectional(
            LSTM(
                params["units"],
                return_sequences=True
            )
        ),

        GlobalAveragePooling1D(),

        Dense(
            128,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        Dropout(params["dropout"]),

        Dense(
            num_classes,
            activation="softmax"
        )
    ])

    model.compile(
        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=params["learning_rate"]
        ),
        loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    return model


# ============================================================
# 7. FITNESS FUNCTION
# ============================================================

fitness_cache = {}


def evaluate_fitness(position):

    params = decode_parameters(position)

    cache_key = tuple(
        round(float(v), 5)
        for v in position
    )

    if cache_key in fitness_cache:
        return fitness_cache[cache_key]

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    model = build_afs_cmn(params)

    model.fit(
        X_fit_3d,
        y_fit,
        validation_data=(X_val_3d, y_val),
        epochs=SEARCH_EPOCHS,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        class_weight=class_weights,
        verbose=0
    )

    val_prob = model.predict(
        X_val_3d,
        verbose=0
    )

    val_pred = np.argmax(
        val_prob,
        axis=1
    )

    val_f1 = f1_score(
        y_val,
        val_pred,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    # Lower fitness is better
    fitness = 1.0 - val_f1

    fitness_cache[cache_key] = fitness

    del model

    return fitness


# ============================================================
# 8. GENETIC ALGORITHM (GA)
# ============================================================

def genetic_algorithm():

    population = np.random.uniform(
        LOWER,
        UPPER,
        size=(POPULATION_SIZE, len(LOWER))
    )

    best_position = None
    best_fitness = float("inf")

    for iteration in range(OPTIMIZER_ITERATIONS):

        fitness_values = np.array([
            evaluate_fitness(individual)
            for individual in population
        ])

        best_index = np.argmin(fitness_values)

        if fitness_values[best_index] < best_fitness:

            best_fitness = fitness_values[best_index]
            best_position = population[best_index].copy()


        # Elitism
        new_population = [
            best_position.copy()
        ]

        while len(new_population) < POPULATION_SIZE:

            # Select two parents using tournament selection
            candidates = np.random.choice(
                POPULATION_SIZE,
                size=2,
                replace=False
            )

            parent1 = population[
                candidates[np.argmin(fitness_values[candidates])]
            ]

            candidates = np.random.choice(
                POPULATION_SIZE,
                size=2,
                replace=False
            )

            parent2 = population[
                candidates[np.argmin(fitness_values[candidates])]
            ]

            # Arithmetic crossover
            alpha = np.random.rand()

            child = (
                alpha * parent1
                + (1 - alpha) * parent2
            )

            # Mutation
            mutation = np.random.normal(
                0,
                [0.3, 12, 12, 0.05]
            )

            child = child + mutation

            child = np.clip(
                child,
                LOWER,
                UPPER
            )

            new_population.append(child)

        population = np.array(new_population)

    return best_position, best_fitness


# ============================================================
# 9. PARTICLE SWARM OPTIMIZATION (PSO)
# ============================================================

def particle_swarm_optimization():

    positions = np.random.uniform(
        LOWER,
        UPPER,
        size=(POPULATION_SIZE, len(LOWER))
    )

    velocities = np.zeros_like(positions)

    personal_best = positions.copy()

    personal_fitness = np.array([
        evaluate_fitness(p)
        for p in positions
    ])

    global_index = np.argmin(personal_fitness)

    global_best = personal_best[global_index].copy()
    global_fitness = personal_fitness[global_index]

    inertia = 0.7
    cognitive = 1.5
    social = 1.5

    for iteration in range(OPTIMIZER_ITERATIONS):

        for i in range(POPULATION_SIZE):

            r1 = np.random.rand(len(LOWER))
            r2 = np.random.rand(len(LOWER))

            velocities[i] = (
                inertia * velocities[i]
                + cognitive * r1 * (
                    personal_best[i] - positions[i]
                )
                + social * r2 * (
                    global_best - positions[i]
                )
            )

            positions[i] += velocities[i]

            positions[i] = np.clip(
                positions[i],
                LOWER,
                UPPER
            )

            current_fitness = evaluate_fitness(
                positions[i]
            )

            if current_fitness < personal_fitness[i]:

                personal_fitness[i] = current_fitness
                personal_best[i] = positions[i].copy()

            if current_fitness < global_fitness:

                global_fitness = current_fitness
                global_best = positions[i].copy()

    return global_best, global_fitness


# ============================================================
# 10. ARTIFICIAL FISH SWARM ALGORITHM (AFSA)
# ============================================================

def artificial_fish_swarm():

    population = np.random.uniform(
        LOWER,
        UPPER,
        size=(POPULATION_SIZE, len(LOWER))
    )

    best_position = None
    best_fitness = float("inf")

    visual = np.array([
        0.5,
        15.0,
        15.0,
        0.05
    ])

    step_factor = 0.5

    for iteration in range(OPTIMIZER_ITERATIONS):

        fitness_values = np.array([
            evaluate_fitness(individual)
            for individual in population
        ])

        best_index = np.argmin(fitness_values)

        if fitness_values[best_index] < best_fitness:

            best_fitness = fitness_values[best_index]
            best_position = population[best_index].copy()

        for i in range(POPULATION_SIZE):

            # AFSA foraging / following behavior
            random_direction = np.random.uniform(
                -1,
                1,
                size=len(LOWER)
            )

            neighbor = (
                population[i]
                + visual * random_direction
            )

            neighbor = np.clip(
                neighbor,
                LOWER,
                UPPER
            )

            neighbor_fitness = evaluate_fitness(
                neighbor
            )

            current_fitness = evaluate_fitness(
                population[i]
            )

            if neighbor_fitness < current_fitness:

                direction = neighbor - population[i]

                population[i] += (
                    step_factor * direction
                )

            else:

                # Random movement when no better neighbor exists
                population[i] += (
                    step_factor
                    * visual
                    * random_direction
                )

            population[i] = np.clip(
                population[i],
                LOWER,
                UPPER
            )


    # Evaluate final population and retain the best solution
    final_fitness = np.array([
        evaluate_fitness(individual)
        for individual in population
    ])

    final_index = np.argmin(final_fitness)

    if final_fitness[final_index] < best_fitness:

        best_fitness = final_fitness[final_index]
        best_position = population[final_index].copy()

    return best_position, best_fitness


# ============================================================
# 11. FINAL TRAINING AND TEST EVALUATION
# ============================================================

def final_training(
    optimizer_name,
    params,
    total_start_time,
    search_fitness=None
):

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    model = build_afs_cmn(params)

    early_stop = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=PATIENCE,
        restore_best_weights=True,
        verbose=0
    )

    history = model.fit(
        X_fit_3d,
        y_fit,
        validation_data=(X_val_3d, y_val),
        epochs=FINAL_EPOCHS,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        class_weight=class_weights,
        callbacks=[early_stop],
        verbose=0
    )

    # Convergence epoch: epoch with minimum validation loss
    val_losses = history.history["val_loss"]

    convergence_epoch = int(
        np.argmin(val_losses) + 1
    )

    # Test evaluation
    probabilities = model.predict(
        X_test_3d,
        verbose=0
    )

    predictions = np.argmax(
        probabilities,
        axis=1
    )

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_test,
        predictions
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_test,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_test,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_test,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    # Fitness value based on validation macro-F1
    if search_fitness is None:

        val_prob = model.predict(
            X_val_3d,
            verbose=0
        )

        val_pred = np.argmax(
            val_prob,
            axis=1
        )

        val_macro_f1 = f1_score(
            y_val,
            val_pred,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        )

        fitness_value = 1.0 - val_macro_f1

    else:

        fitness_value = search_fitness

    execution_time = time.perf_counter() - total_start_time

    # Save model
    model.save(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            f"{optimizer_name}_AFS_CMN.keras"
        )
    )

    # Save training history
    pd.DataFrame(history.history).to_csv(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            f"{optimizer_name}_Training_History.csv"
        ),
        index=False
    )


    return {
        "Optimizer": optimizer_name,
        "Accuracy": accuracy,
        "Precision": precision,
        "Recall": recall,
        "F1-score": f1,
        "Convergence Epoch": convergence_epoch,
        "Execution Time (s)": execution_time,
        "Efficient Fitness Value": fitness_value
    }


# ============================================================
# 12. ADAM BASELINE
# ============================================================

results = []

print("\n" + "=" * 85)
print("1. ADAM BASELINE")
print("=" * 85)

adam_params = {
    "learning_rate": 0.001,
    "filters": 64,
    "units": 64,
    "dropout": 0.30
}

start_time = time.perf_counter()

adam_result = final_training(
    "Adam",

)

results.append(adam_result)


# ============================================================
# 13. GENETIC ALGORITHM
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 85)
print("2. GENETIC ALGORITHM (GA)")
print("=" * 85)

start_time = time.perf_counter()

ga_position, ga_fitness = genetic_algorithm()

ga_params = decode_parameters(ga_position)

ga_result = final_training(
    "GA",

# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 85)
print("3. PARTICLE SWARM OPTIMIZATION (PSO)")
print("=" * 85)

start_time = time.perf_counter()

pso_position, pso_fitness = particle_swarm_optimization()

pso_params = decode_parameters(pso_position)

    "PSO",

import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score
)
from sklearn.utils.class_weight import compute_class_weight

from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE

from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Input,
    Conv1D,
    BatchNormalization,
    Bidirectional,
    LSTM,
    GlobalAveragePooling1D,
    Dense,
    Dropout
)
from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import EarlyStopping

# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TRAIN_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_train_scaled.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\AFS_CMN_5Fold_Cross_Validation"
)

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGET = "Crisis_Risk_Level"

N_SPLITS = 5
RANDOM_STATE = 42

EPOCHS = 5
BATCH_SIZE = 32
PATIENCE = 8

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Use the best hyperparameters selected by AFSA.
# Replace these defaults with your actual saved AFSA values
# if they differ.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

LEARNING_RATE = 0.001
CNN_FILTERS = 64
BILSTM_UNITS = 64
DROPOUT_RATE = 0.30

np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
tf.random.set_seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD TRAINING DATA
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)

exclude_columns = [
    TARGET,
    "Crisis_Label"
]

feature_columns = [
    col for col in df.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns
    if col not in exclude_columns
]

X = df[feature_columns].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
y = df[TARGET].to_numpy(dtype=np.int32)

if not np.isfinite(X).all():
    raise ValueError("Dataset contains NaN or infinite feature values.")

num_classes = len(np.unique(y))

print("=" * 90)
print("5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION - PROPOSED AFS-CMN MODEL")
print("=" * 90)

# ============================================================
# 3. AFS-CMN MODEL
# ============================================================

def build_afs_cmn(input_shape, num_classes):

    model = Sequential([
        Input(shape=input_shape),

        Conv1D(
            filters=CNN_FILTERS,
            kernel_size=3,
            padding="same",
            activation="relu"
        ),

        BatchNormalization(),

        Bidirectional(
            LSTM(
                BILSTM_UNITS,
                return_sequences=True
            )
        ),

        GlobalAveragePooling1D(),

        Dense(
            128,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),

        Dense(
            num_classes,
            activation="softmax"
        )
    ])

    model.compile(
        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=LEARNING_RATE
        ),
        loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    return model


# ============================================================
# 4. STRATIFIED 5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION
# ============================================================

skf = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=N_SPLITS,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

fold_results = []

for fold, (train_index, val_index) in enumerate(
    skf.split(X, y),
    start=1
):

    print("\n" + "=" * 90)
    print(f"RUNNING FOLD {fold}/{N_SPLITS}")
    print("=" * 90)

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

    seed = RANDOM_STATE + fold

    np.random.seed(seed)
    random.seed(seed)
    tf.random.set_seed(seed)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.1 Split fold data
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    X_fold_train = X[train_index]
    X_fold_val = X[val_index]

    y_fold_train = y[train_index]
    y_fold_val = y[val_index]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.2 PCA: Fit only on fold training data
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    pca = PCA(
        n_components=0.95,
        svd_solver="full"
    )

    X_fold_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(
        X_fold_train
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_fold_val_pca = pca.transform(
        X_fold_val
    ).astype(np.float32)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.3 SMOTE: Training fold only
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    smote = SMOTE(
        random_state=seed,
        k_neighbors=5
    )

    X_fold_balanced, y_fold_balanced = smote.fit_resample(
        X_fold_train_pca,
        y_fold_train
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.4 Class weights
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # SMOTE balances the training classes, so no additional
    # class weighting is necessary here.

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.5 Reshape for CNN-BiLSTM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    X_fold_balanced = X_fold_balanced.reshape(
        X_fold_balanced.shape[0],
        X_fold_balanced.shape[1],
        1
    )

    X_fold_val_pca = X_fold_val_pca.reshape(
        X_fold_val_pca.shape[0],
        X_fold_val_pca.shape[1],
        1
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.6 Build proposed model
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    model = build_afs_cmn(
        input_shape=(
            X_fold_balanced.shape[1],
            1
        ),
        num_classes=num_classes
    )

    early_stopping = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=PATIENCE,
        restore_best_weights=True,
        verbose=0
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.7 Train model
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    history = model.fit(
        X_fold_balanced,
        y_fold_balanced,
        validation_data=(
            X_fold_val_pca,
            y_fold_val
        ),
        epochs=EPOCHS,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        callbacks=[early_stopping],
        verbose=0
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.8 Validation prediction
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    probabilities = model.predict(
        X_fold_val_pca,
        verbose=0
    )

    predictions = np.argmax(
        probabilities,
        axis=1
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.9 Calculate metrics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_fold_val,
        predictions
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_fold_val,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_fold_val,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_fold_val,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    fold_results.append({
        "Fold": f"Fold {fold}",
        "Accuracy": accuracy,
        "Precision": precision,
        "Recall": recall,
        "F1-Score": f1
    })

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4.10 Print individual fold results
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # Save fold model
    model.save(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            f"AFS_CMN_Fold_{fold}.keras"
        )
    )

    # Save fold history
    pd.DataFrame(history.history).to_csv(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            f"AFS_CMN_Fold_{fold}_History.csv"
        ),
        index=False
    )

# ============================================================
# 5. CALCULATE MEAN AND STANDARD DEVIATION
# ============================================================

results_df = pd.DataFrame(fold_results)

metric_columns = [
    "Accuracy",
    "Precision",
    "Recall",
    "F1-Score"
]

mean_values = results_df[metric_columns].mean()
std_values = results_df[metric_columns].std(ddof=1)

summary_row = {
    "Fold": "Mean ± Std"
}

for metric in metric_columns:
    summary_row[metric] = (
        f"{mean_values[metric]:.3f} ± {std_values[metric]:.3f}"
    )

# Format individual folds
display_df = results_df.copy()

for metric in metric_columns:
    display_df[metric] = display_df[metric].map(
        lambda value: f"{value:.3f}"
    )

display_df = pd.concat(
    [
        display_df,
        pd.DataFrame([summary_row])
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

# ============================================================
# 6. PRINT FINAL TABLE
# ============================================================

print("\n\n")
print("=" * 100)
print("5-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION RESULTS")
print("=" * 100)

print(display_df.to_string(index=False))

print("=" * 100)

# ============================================================
# 7. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

csv_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "AFS_CMN_5Fold_Cross_Validation.csv"
)

display_df.to_csv(
    csv_path,
    index=False
)

# Save numerical summary separately
summary_numeric = pd.DataFrame({
    "Metric": metric_columns,
    "Mean": [mean_values[m] for m in metric_columns],
    "Standard Deviation": [std_values[m] for m in metric_columns]
})

summary_numeric.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "AFS_CMN_5Fold_Mean_Std.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print("\nResults saved:", csv_path)

import os
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    f1_score
)

from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE

from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras.layers import (
    Input,
    Conv1D,
    BatchNormalization,
    Bidirectional,
    LSTM,
    GlobalAveragePooling1D,
    Dense,
    Dropout
)
from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import EarlyStopping

# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TRAIN_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_train_scaled.csv"
)

TEST_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_test_scaled.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output\AFS_CMN_SMOTE_Comparison"
)

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TARGET = "Crisis_Risk_Level"

RANDOM_STATE = 42
EPOCHS = 5
BATCH_SIZE = 32
PATIENCE = 8

# Use the hyperparameters selected by your AFSA experiment.
LEARNING_RATE = 0.001
CNN_FILTERS = 64
BILSTM_UNITS = 64
DROPOUT_RATE = 0.30

np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
tf.random.set_seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD DATASETS
# ============================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

exclude_columns = [
    TARGET,
    "Crisis_Label"
]

feature_columns = [
    col for col in train_df.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns
    if col not in exclude_columns and col in test_df.columns
]

X = train_df[feature_columns].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
y = train_df[TARGET].to_numpy(dtype=np.int32)

X_test_original = test_df[feature_columns].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
y_test = test_df[TARGET].to_numpy(dtype=np.int32)

if not np.isfinite(X).all() or not np.isfinite(X_test_original).all():
    raise ValueError("Features contain NaN or infinite values.")

num_classes = len(np.unique(y))

print("=" * 85)
print("AFS-CMN WITH AND WITHOUT SMOTE COMPARISON")
print("=" * 85)

# ============================================================
# 3. TRAINING AND VALIDATION SPLIT
# ============================================================

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X,
    y,
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    stratify=y
)

# ============================================================
# 4. PCA TRANSFORMATION
# Fit PCA on training data only
# ============================================================

pca = PCA(
    n_components=0.95,
    svd_solver="full"
)

X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(
    X_train
).astype(np.float32)

X_val_pca = pca.transform(
    X_val
).astype(np.float32)

X_test_pca = pca.transform(
    X_test_original
).astype(np.float32)

# ============================================================
# 5. AFS-CMN MODEL ARCHITECTURE
# CNN + BIDIRECTIONAL LSTM
# ============================================================

def build_afs_cmn(input_shape, num_classes):

    model = Sequential([
        Input(shape=input_shape),

        Conv1D(
            filters=CNN_FILTERS,
            kernel_size=3,
            padding="same",
            activation="relu"
        ),

        BatchNormalization(),

        Bidirectional(
            LSTM(
                BILSTM_UNITS,
                return_sequences=True
            )
        ),

        GlobalAveragePooling1D(),

        Dense(
            128,
            activation="relu"
        ),

        Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),

        Dense(
            num_classes,
            activation="softmax"
        )
    ])

    model.compile(
        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=LEARNING_RATE
        ),
        loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    return model


# ============================================================
# 6. DATA RESHAPING
# ============================================================

def reshape_for_cnn(X):

    return X.reshape(
        X.shape[0],
        X.shape[1],
        1
    ).astype(np.float32)


X_train_3d = reshape_for_cnn(X_train_pca)
X_val_3d = reshape_for_cnn(X_val_pca)
X_test_3d = reshape_for_cnn(X_test_pca)

# ============================================================
# 7. TRAINING AND EVALUATION FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def train_and_evaluate(
    model_name,
    X_training,
    y_training
):

    print("\n" + "=" * 85)
    print("TRAINING:", model_name)
    print("=" * 85)

    tf.keras.backend.clear_session()
    tf.random.set_seed(RANDOM_STATE)

    model = build_afs_cmn(
        input_shape=(X_training.shape[1], 1),
        num_classes=num_classes
    )

    early_stopping = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=PATIENCE,
        restore_best_weights=True,
        verbose=1
    )

    history = model.fit(
        X_training,
        y_training,
        validation_data=(X_val_3d, y_val),
        epochs=EPOCHS,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        callbacks=[early_stopping],
        verbose=0
    )

    # Test prediction
    probabilities = model.predict(
        X_test_3d,
        verbose=0
    )

    predictions = np.argmax(
        probabilities,
        axis=1
    )

    # Calculate performance metrics
    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_test,
        predictions
    )

    precision = precision_score(
        y_test,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    recall = recall_score(
        y_test,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    f1 = f1_score(
        y_test,
        predictions,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    metrics = {
        "Method": model_name,
        "Accuracy": accuracy,
        "Precision": precision,
        "Recall": recall,
        "F1-Score": f1
    }

    # Save model and training history
    safe_name = model_name.replace(" ", "_").replace("[", "").replace("]", "")

    model.save(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            f"{safe_name}.keras"
        )
    )

    pd.DataFrame(history.history).to_csv(
        os.path.join(
            OUTPUT_DIR,
            f"{safe_name}_History.csv"
        ),
        index=False
    )

    return metrics


# ============================================================
# 8. AFS-CMN WITHOUT SMOTE
# ============================================================

results = []

metrics_without = train_and_evaluate(
    model_name="AFS-CMN without SMOTE",
    X_training=X_train_3d,
    y_training=y_train
)

results.append(metrics_without)

# ============================================================
# 9. APPLY SMOTE TO TRAINING DATA ONLY
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 85)
print("APPLYING SMOTE TO TRAINING DATA")
print("=" * 85)

smote = SMOTE(
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    k_neighbors=5
)

X_train_smote, y_train_smote = smote.fit_resample(
    X_train_pca,
    y_train
)

X_train_smote_3d = reshape_for_cnn(
    X_train_smote
)

# ============================================================
# 10. AFS-CMN WITH SMOTE [PROPOSED]
# ============================================================

metrics_with = train_and_evaluate(
    model_name="AFS-CMN with SMOTE [Proposed]",
    X_training=X_train_smote_3d,
    y_training=y_train_smote
)

results.append(metrics_with)

# ============================================================
# 11. FINAL COMPARISON TABLE
# ============================================================

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

print("\n")
print("=" * 105)
print("AFS-CMN PERFORMANCE COMPARISON")
print("=" * 105)

print(
    results_df.to_string(
        index=False,
        formatters={
            "Accuracy": "{:.3f}".format,
            "Precision": "{:.3f}".format,
            "Recall": "{:.3f}".format,
            "F1-Score": "{:.3f}".format
        }
    )
)

print("=" * 105)

# ============================================================
# 12. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

results_path = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "AFS_CMN_SMOTE_Comparison.csv"
)

results_df.to_csv(
    results_path,
    index=False
)

print("\nResults saved:", results_path)

import os
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: MODEL PATHS
# ============================================================

BASELINE_MODEL_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\AFS_CMN_Ablation_Study\Baseline_CNN.keras"
)

PROPOSED_MODEL_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Step_6_8_AFS_CMN_Training\AFS_CMN_Proposed_Model.keras"
)

# Original scaled test dataset: 17 features
BASELINE_TEST_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_test_scaled.csv"
)

# PCA test dataset: 16 components
PROPOSED_TEST_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Step_4_PCA\psychological_crisis_test_PCA.csv"
)

TARGET_COLUMN = "Crisis_Risk_Level"

WARMUP_RUNS = 20
INFERENCE_RUNS = 200

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: CHECK FILES
# ============================================================

required_files = [
    BASELINE_MODEL_PATH,
    PROPOSED_MODEL_PATH,
    BASELINE_TEST_PATH,
    PROPOSED_TEST_PATH
]

for file_path in required_files:
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"File not found: {file_path}")

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: LOAD TEST DATASETS
# ============================================================

baseline_df = pd.read_csv(BASELINE_TEST_PATH)
proposed_df = pd.read_csv(PROPOSED_TEST_PATH)

def extract_features(df):
    if TARGET_COLUMN in df.columns:
        df = df.drop(columns=[TARGET_COLUMN])

    # Exclude non-numerical columns
    df = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])

    df = df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    if df.isnull().any().any():
        raise ValueError("Missing or infinite values found in test features.")

    return df.astype(np.float32)

X_baseline = extract_features(baseline_df)
X_proposed = extract_features(proposed_df)

if len(X_baseline) != len(X_proposed):
    raise ValueError(
        "The two test datasets contain different numbers of samples. "
        "Use test datasets created from the same train-test split."
    )

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: LOAD MODELS
# ============================================================

print("\nLoading saved models...")

baseline_model = tf.keras.models.load_model(
    BASELINE_MODEL_PATH,
    compile=False
)

proposed_model = tf.keras.models.load_model(
    PROPOSED_MODEL_PATH,
    compile=False
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: CHECK MODEL INPUT DIMENSIONS
# ============================================================

def get_input_shape(model):
    shape = model.input_shape

    if isinstance(shape, list):
        if len(shape) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Only single-input models are supported.")
        shape = shape[0]

    return tuple(shape)


baseline_shape = get_input_shape(baseline_model)
proposed_shape = get_input_shape(proposed_model)

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: PREPARE MODEL INPUT
# ============================================================

def prepare_input(X, model):

    shape = get_input_shape(model)

    if len(shape) == 2:

        expected_features = shape[1]

        if expected_features is not None:
            if X.shape[1] != expected_features:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Model expects {expected_features} features, "
                    f"but dataset contains {X.shape[1]}."
                )

        model_input = X.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

    elif len(shape) == 3:

        expected_features = shape[1]
        expected_channels = shape[2]

        if expected_features is not None:
            if X.shape[1] != expected_features:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Model expects {expected_features} positions, "
                    f"but dataset contains {X.shape[1]}."
                )

        if expected_channels not in (None, 1):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported channel dimension.")

        model_input = X.to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
        model_input = model_input.reshape(
            model_input.shape[0],
            model_input.shape[1],
            1
        )

    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported input shape: {shape}")

    return model_input


X_baseline_input = prepare_input(
    X_baseline,
    baseline_model
)

X_proposed_input = prepare_input(
    X_proposed,
    proposed_model
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 7: MEASURE SINGLE-SAMPLE INFERENCE TIME
# ============================================================

def measure_inference_time(
    model,
    X,
    warmup_runs=20,
    inference_runs=200
):

    # Warm-up
    for _ in range(warmup_runs):
        output = model(X[:1], training=False)

        if isinstance(output, (list, tuple)):
            output = output[0]

        _ = output.numpy()

    # Actual measurement
    start_time = time.perf_counter()

    for i in range(inference_runs):

        index = i % len(X)

        output = model(
            X[index:index + 1],
            training=False
        )

        if isinstance(output, (list, tuple)):
            output = output[0]

        # Synchronize TensorFlow execution
        _ = output.numpy()

    end_time = time.perf_counter()

    total_time = end_time - start_time

    average_time_ms = (
        total_time / inference_runs
    ) * 1000

    return average_time_ms


print("\nMeasuring inference time...")

baseline_time = measure_inference_time(
    baseline_model,
    X_baseline_input,
    WARMUP_RUNS,
    INFERENCE_RUNS
)

proposed_time = measure_inference_time(
    proposed_model,
    X_proposed_input,
    WARMUP_RUNS,
    INFERENCE_RUNS
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 8: CALCULATE IMPROVEMENT
# ============================================================

improvement = (
    (baseline_time - proposed_time) / baseline_time
) * 100 if baseline_time > 0 else np.nan

# ============================================================
# STEP 9: PRINT RESULTS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("INFERENCE TIME COMPARISON")
print("=" * 75)

print(f"{'Methods':<30}{'Inference Time (ms)':>25}")
print("-" * 75)

print(
    f"{'AFS (Baseline)':<30}"
    f"{baseline_time:>25.3f}"
)

print(
    f"{'AFS-CMN Proposed':<30}"
    f"{proposed_time:>25.3f}"
)

print(
    f"{'Improvement (%)':<30}"
    f"{improvement:>25.3f}"
)

print("=" * 75)

# ============================================================
# STEP 10: SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Inference_Time_Comparison"
)

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

results = pd.DataFrame({
    "Methods": [
        "AFS (Baseline)",
        "AFS-CMN Proposed",
        "Improvement (%)"
    ],
    "Inference Time (ms)": [
        baseline_time,
        proposed_time,
        improvement
    ]
})

output_file = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "Inference_Time_Comparison.csv"
)

results.to_csv(output_file, index=False)

print("\nResults saved to:")
print(output_file)

print("\nInference time comparison completed successfully.")

# ============================================================

import os

import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf

from scipy.stats import ttest_rel, t

from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.metrics import (

    recall_score,
    f1_score
)

from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import (
    RandomForestClassifier,
    AdaBoostClassifier,
    VotingClassifier
)
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.utils.class_weight import compute_class_weight

from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
tf.get_logger().setLevel("ERROR")

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: PATHS AND SETTINGS
# ============================================================

TRAIN_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_train_scaled.csv"
)

TEST_PATH = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Step_3_Train_Test\psychological_crisis_test_scaled.csv"
)

TARGET = "Crisis_Risk_Level"

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\Existing_Methods_Comparison"
)

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

RANDOM_STATE = 42
N_SPLITS = 5
EPOCHS = 3
BATCH_SIZE = 32

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

if TARGET not in train_df.columns or TARGET not in test_df.columns:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Target column '{TARGET}' must be present in both files."
    )

exclude_columns = [TARGET, "Crisis_Label"]

X_train = train_df.drop(
    columns=[c for c in exclude_columns if c in train_df.columns]
)

X_test = test_df.drop(
    columns=[c for c in exclude_columns if c in test_df.columns]
)

# Keep numerical columns only
X_train = X_train.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
X_test = X_test[X_train.columns]

y_train = train_df[TARGET].astype(int).to_numpy()
y_test = test_df[TARGET].astype(int).to_numpy()

X_train = X_train.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
X_test = X_test.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

# Imputation is fitted on training data only
imputer = SimpleImputer(strategy="median")

X_train = imputer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test = imputer.transform(X_test)

X_train = np.asarray(X_train, dtype=np.float32)
X_test = np.asarray(X_test, dtype=np.float32)

classes = np.unique(y_train)

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: DEFINE CLASSIFICATION MODELS
# ============================================================

def get_models():

    # Boosting-SVM: AdaBoost ensemble of SVM-based classifiers
    # AdaBoost itself requires sample-weight-compatible estimators.
    # Use an RBF SVM in a weighted boosting implementation below.

    models = {}

    models["C4.5"] = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        criterion="entropy",
        max_depth=8,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    models["CART"] = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        criterion="gini",
        max_depth=8,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    models["LR"] = LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=2000,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    models["Light GBM"] = None

    models["LR + Light GBM"] = None

    models["RF"] = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=None,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        n_jobs=-1
    )

    models["DT"] = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        criterion="gini",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    return models


def fit_boosting_svm(X, y, n_estimators=5):

    # Weighted AdaBoost-style ensemble using SVM sample weights.
    n = len(y)
    sample_weights = np.ones(n) / n

    estimators = []
    estimator_weights = []

    for _ in range(n_estimators):

        svm = SVC(
            kernel="rbf",
            C=1.0,
            probability=True,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE
        )

        svm.fit(
            X,
            y,
            sample_weight=sample_weights
        )

        predictions = svm.predict(X)
        incorrect = (predictions != y).astype(float)

        error = np.sum(sample_weights * incorrect)

        if error >= 1 - (1 / len(classes)):
            break

        error = max(error, 1e-10)

        alpha = np.log(
            (1 - error) / error
        ) + np.log(len(classes) - 1)

        estimators.append(svm)
        estimator_weights.append(alpha)

        sample_weights *= np.exp(alpha * incorrect)
        sample_weights /= sample_weights.sum()

        if error <= 1e-10:
            break

    if not estimators:
        raise RuntimeError("Boosting-SVM could not fit a useful estimator.")

    return estimators, np.asarray(estimator_weights)


def predict_boosting_svm(ensemble, X):

    estimators, weights = ensemble

    probabilities = np.zeros(
        (len(X), len(classes)),
        dtype=float
    )

    for estimator, weight in zip(estimators, weights):

        estimator_probs = estimator.predict_proba(X)

        # Align probability columns with global class order
        aligned = np.zeros_like(probabilities)

        for j, cls in enumerate(estimator.classes_):
            class_index = np.where(classes == cls)[0][0]
            aligned[:, class_index] = estimator_probs[:, j]

        probabilities += weight * aligned

    return classes[np.argmax(probabilities, axis=1)]


# ============================================================
# STEP 4: LIGHTGBM
# ============================================================

try:
    from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
except ImportError:
    raise ImportError(
        "LightGBM is not installed. Run:\n"
        "%pip install lightgbm"
    )


def create_lightgbm():
    return LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=-1,
        num_leaves=20,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        verbosity=-1
    )


# ============================================================
# STEP 5: AFS-CMN ARCHITECTURE
# ============================================================

def build_afs_cmn(input_shape, number_of_classes):

    inputs = tf.keras.Input(shape=input_shape)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Conv1D(
        filters=64,
        kernel_size=3,
        padding="same",
        activation="relu"
    )(inputs)

    x = tf.keras.layers.BatchNormalization()(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.MaxPooling1D(
        pool_size=2,
        padding="same"
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Bidirectional(
        tf.keras.layers.LSTM(
            64,
            return_sequences=True
        )
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.GlobalAveragePooling1D()(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        64,
        activation="relu"
    )(x)

    x = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(0.3)(x)

    outputs = tf.keras.layers.Dense(
        number_of_classes,
        activation="softmax"
    )(x)

    model = tf.keras.Model(inputs, outputs)

    model.compile(
        optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(
            learning_rate=0.001
        ),
        loss="sparse_categorical_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"]
    )

    return model


def train_afs_cmn(X_fit, y_fit, X_eval, y_eval):

    # PCA is fitted only on the fitting partition.
    pca = PCA(
        n_components=0.95,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    X_fit_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_fit)
    X_eval_pca = pca.transform(X_eval)

    # SMOTE is applied only to fitting data.
    smote = SMOTE(random_state=RANDOM_STATE)

    X_balanced, y_balanced = smote.fit_resample(
        X_fit_pca,
        y_fit
    )

    X_balanced = X_balanced.reshape(
        X_balanced.shape[0],
        X_balanced.shape[1],
        1
    )

    X_eval_model = X_eval_pca.reshape(
        X_eval_pca.shape[0],
        X_eval_pca.shape[1],
        1
    )

    model = build_afs_cmn(
        (X_balanced.shape[1], 1),
        len(classes)
    )

    model.fit(
        X_balanced,
        y_balanced,
        epochs=EPOCHS,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        verbose=0,
        validation_data=(X_eval_model, y_eval),
        callbacks=[
            tf.keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
                monitor="val_loss",
                patience=5,
                restore_best_weights=True
            )
        ]
    )

    probabilities = model.predict(
        X_eval_model,
        verbose=0
    )

    predictions = classes[np.argmax(probabilities, axis=1)]

    return predictions


# ============================================================
# STEP 6: METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    return {
        "Accuracy": accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred),
        "Precision": precision_score(
            y_true, y_pred,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        ),
        "Recall": recall_score(
            y_true, y_pred,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        ),
        "F1-Score": f1_score(
            y_true, y_pred,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0
        )
    }


# ============================================================
# STEP 7: TRAIN AND EVALUATE EXISTING METHODS
# ============================================================

results = []

model_objects = get_models()

print("\n" + "=" * 85)
print("TRAINING EXISTING CLASSIFICATION METHODS")
print("=" * 85)

# Boosting-SVM
print("\nTraining Boosting-SVM...")

boosting_model = fit_boosting_svm(
    X_train,
    y_train
)

boosting_predictions = predict_boosting_svm(
    boosting_model,
    X_test
)

results.append({
    "Methods": "Boosting-SVM",
    **calculate_metrics(y_test, boosting_predictions)
})

# C4.5, CART, LR, RF, DT
for name in ["C4.5", "CART", "LR", "RF", "DT"]:

    print(f"\nTraining {name}...")

    model = model_objects[name]
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    predictions = model.predict(X_test)

    results.append({
        "Methods": name,
        **calculate_metrics(y_test, predictions)
    })

# LightGBM
print("\nTraining Light GBM...")

lgbm_model = create_lightgbm()
lgbm_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

lgbm_predictions = lgbm_model.predict(X_test)

results.append({
    "Methods": "Light GBM",
    **calculate_metrics(y_test, lgbm_predictions)
})

# LR + LightGBM soft voting ensemble
print("\nTraining LR + Light GBM...")

lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000,
    class_weight="balanced",
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

ensemble_model = VotingClassifier(
    estimators=[
        ("LR", lr_model),
        ("LightGBM", create_lightgbm())
    ],
    voting="soft"
)

ensemble_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

ensemble_predictions = ensemble_model.predict(X_test)

results.append({
    "Methods": "LR + Light GBM",
    **calculate_metrics(y_test, ensemble_predictions)
})

# AFS-CMN Proposed
print("\nTraining AFS-CMN Proposed...")

afs_predictions = train_afs_cmn(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    X_test,
    y_test
)

results.append({
    "Methods": "AFS-CMN [Proposed]",
    **calculate_metrics(y_test, afs_predictions)
})

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# STEP 9: FIVE-FOLD PAIRED STATISTICAL COMPARISON
# AFS-CMN vs DT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 100)
print("FIVE-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION: AFS-CMN VS DT")
print("=" * 100)

cv = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=N_SPLITS,
    shuffle=True,
    random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

cv_results = {
    "Accuracy": {"AFS-CMN": [], "DT": []},
    "Precision": {"AFS-CMN": [], "DT": []},
    "Recall": {"AFS-CMN": [], "DT": []},
    "F1-Score": {"AFS-CMN": [], "DT": []}
}

for fold, (fit_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(
    cv.split(X_train, y_train), start=1
):

    print(f"\nProcessing Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS}")

    X_fit, X_val = X_train[fit_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_fit, y_val = y_train[fit_idx], y_train[val_idx]

    # DT
    dt_model = DecisionTreeClassifier(
        criterion="gini",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    dt_model.fit(X_fit, y_fit)
    dt_predictions = dt_model.predict(X_val)

    dt_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_val,
        dt_predictions
    )

    # AFS-CMN
    afs_cv_predictions = train_afs_cmn(
        X_fit,
        y_fit,
        X_val,
        y_val
    )

    afs_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_val,
        afs_cv_predictions
    )

    for metric in metric_columns:
        cv_results[metric]["AFS-CMN"].append(
            afs_metrics[metric]
        )

        cv_results[metric]["DT"].append(
            dt_metrics[metric]
        )

# ============================================================
# STEP 10: PAIRED T-TEST AND 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL
# ============================================================

statistical_rows = []

for metric in metric_columns:

    afs_values = np.asarray(
        cv_results[metric]["AFS-CMN"],
        dtype=float
    )

    dt_values = np.asarray(
        cv_results[metric]["DT"],
        dtype=float
    )

    mean_afs = np.mean(afs_values)
    sd_afs = np.std(afs_values, ddof=1)

    mean_dt = np.mean(dt_values)
    sd_dt = np.std(dt_values, ddof=1)

    differences = afs_values - dt_values

    mean_difference = np.mean(differences)

    t_value, p_value = ttest_rel(
        afs_values,
        dt_values
    )

    standard_error = (
        np.std(differences, ddof=1) /
        np.sqrt(N_SPLITS)
    )

    critical_t = t.ppf(
        0.975,
        df=N_SPLITS - 1
    )

    ci_lower = mean_difference - critical_t * standard_error
    ci_upper = mean_difference + critical_t * standard_error

    statistical_rows.append({
        "Metrics": metric,
        "AFS-CMN (Mean±SD)": f"{mean_afs:.3f} ± {sd_afs:.4f}",
        "DT (Mean±SD)": f"{mean_dt:.3f} ± {sd_dt:.4f}",
        "Mean Difference": mean_difference,
        "t-value": t_value,
        "p-value": p_value,
        "95% CI": f"[{ci_lower:.4f}, {ci_upper:.4f}]"
    })

statistical_df = pd.DataFrame(statistical_rows)

# ============================================================
# STEP 11: PRINT STATISTICAL TABLE
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 120)
print("STATISTICAL COMPARISON: AFS-CMN VS DT")
print("=" * 120)

print(
    statistical_df.to_string(
        index=False,
        formatters={
            "Mean Difference": lambda x: f"{x:.4f}",
            "t-value": lambda x: f"{x:.2f}",
            "p-value": lambda x: f"{x:.3f}"
        }
    )
)

statistical_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "AFS_CMN_vs_DT_Statistical_Comparison.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 12: SAVE FOLD-WISE RESULTS
# ============================================================

fold_rows = []

for metric in metric_columns:
    for fold in range(N_SPLITS):

        fold_rows.append({
            "Metric": metric,
            "Fold": fold + 1,
            "AFS-CMN": cv_results[metric]["AFS-CMN"][fold],
            "DT": cv_results[metric]["DT"][fold]
        })

fold_df = pd.DataFrame(fold_rows)

fold_df.to_csv(
    os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "AFS_CMN_DT_Fold_Wise_Results.csv"
    ),
    index=False
)

print(OUTPUT_DIR)

plt.ylabel('Actual Class', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)

# Tick labels
plt.xticks(rotation=0, fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(rotation=0, fontsize=10)

# Title (optional)
plt.title('Confusion Matrix', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.show()

# ============================================================
# PLOT 3: ROC CURVE
# MULTI-CLASS ONE-VS-REST
# ============================================================

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7))

roc_auc_values = []

for i, class_name in enumerate(CLASS_NAMES):

    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(
        y_test_binary[:, i],
        y_prob[:, i]
    )

    roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)
    roc_auc_values.append(roc_auc)

    ax.plot(
        fpr,
        tpr,
        linestyle=curve_styles[i],
        linewidth=2.5,
        label=f"{class_name} (AUC = {roc_auc:.3f})"
    )

# Micro-average ROC
fpr_micro, tpr_micro, _ = roc_curve(
    y_test_binary.ravel(),
    y_prob.ravel()
)

micro_auc = auc(
    fpr_micro,
    tpr_micro
)

ax.plot(
    fpr_micro,
    tpr_micro,
    linewidth=2.5,
    linestyle="-",
    label=f"Micro-average (AUC = {micro_auc:.3f})"
)

# Random classifier reference
ax.plot(
    [0, 1],
    [0, 1],
    linestyle="--",
    linewidth=1.5,
    label="Random Classifier"
)

macro_auc = np.mean(roc_auc_values)

ax.set_xlabel("False Positive Rate", fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylabel("True Positive Rate", fontweight="bold")

ax.set_title(
    "ROC Curve",
    fontweight="bold"
)

ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.05)

ax.grid(
    True,
    linestyle=":",
    linewidth=0.7,
    alpha=0.25
)

ax.legend(
    loc="lower right",
    frameon=True
)

plt.tight_layout()

plt.show()

import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT DIRECTORY

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    r"E:\Projects\6_Crisis Early Warning\Output"
    r"\AFS_CMN_Training_History"
)

# ============================================================
# EXTRACT TRAINING HISTORY
# ============================================================

train_accuracy = history.history["accuracy"]
train_loss = history.history["loss"]

val_accuracy = history.history["val_accuracy"]
val_loss = history.history["val_loss"]

epochs = np.arange(1, len(train_accuracy) + 1)

# ============================================================
# PUBLICATION-QUALITY PLOT SETTINGS
# ============================================================

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.size": 12,
    "axes.labelweight": "bold",
    "axes.titleweight": "bold",
    "axes.titlesize": 15,
    "axes.labelsize": 13,
    "xtick.labelsize": 11,
    "ytick.labelsize": 11,
    "legend.fontsize": 11,
    "figure.dpi": 150,
    "savefig.dpi": 300
})

# ============================================================
# PLOT 1: TRAINING ACCURACY VS TRAINING LOSS
# ACCURACY = RED
# LOSS = VIOLET
# ============================================================

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))

# Accuracy curve
line1 = ax1.plot(
    epochs,
    train_accuracy,
    color="red",
    linewidth=2.5,
    linestyle="-",
    label="Training Accuracy"
)

ax1.set_xlabel("Epochs", fontweight="bold")
ax1.set_ylabel("Training Accuracy", color="red", fontweight="bold")

ax1.tick_params(
    axis="y",
    labelcolor="red"
)

ax1.set_ylim(0, 1.05)

# Loss curve on secondary Y-axis
ax2 = ax1.twinx()

line2 = ax2.plot(
    epochs,
    train_loss,
    color="blue",
    linewidth=2.5,
    linestyle="--",
    label="Training Loss"
)

ax2.set_ylabel("Training Loss", color="blue", fontweight="bold")

ax2.tick_params(
    axis="y",
    labelcolor="blue"
)

# Combined legend
lines = line1 + line2
labels = [line.get_label() for line in lines]

ax1.legend(
    lines,
    labels,
    loc="center right",
    frameon=True
)

ax1.set_title(
    "AFS-CMN Training Accuracy vs Training Loss",
    fontweight="bold"
)

ax1.set_xlim(1, len(epochs))

ax1.grid(
    True,
    linestyle=":",
    linewidth=0.7,
    alpha=0.3
)
